evals.prompt: We just decided we want to reposition our brand for a totally different audience. Can you help cascade that?
evals.expected_output: Should check whether the positioning work is actually already done and captured in marketing-strategy's changelog before proceeding — this skill assumes the positioning decision is finished, not still being made. If there's no marketing-strategy document or changelog entry describing the change, should redirect to marketing-strategy and its positioning-methodology reference first rather than attempting to cascade something that hasn't been decided yet.
assertions: Checks whether the positioning change is already captured in marketing-strategy's changelog
Recognizes this skill doesn't do the positioning work itself
Redirects to marketing-strategy/positioning-methodology if the change isn't yet captured
Does not attempt to cascade an undefined or in-progress positioning change

evals.prompt: We tightened our tagline wording slightly but the core idea and audience are the same. Do we need to redo everything?
evals.expected_output: Should classify this explicitly as a Minor refinement per the Severity table, not a Major repositioning. Should explain that minor refinements need low cascade effort — new work should use the new language, but a full retroactive audit of every surface isn't warranted. Should state the severity explicitly before recommending next steps, per Step 1.
assertions: Classifies the change as a Minor refinement using the skill's severity table
Explains minor refinements don't need a full retroactive audit
States severity explicitly before recommending action
Distinguishes this from a moderate or major cascade

evals.prompt: We changed our target audience and category completely — full repositioning. What do we update first?
evals.expected_output: Should classify this as a Major repositioning requiring the full cascade. Should sequence by exposure risk per Step 3: live/active surfaces (ads, in-flight campaigns, active email/SMS sequences, homepage) first, then owned long-shelf-life content (SEO, pricing page, offers), then partner-facing materials with advance notice, then earned/third-party last. Should not recommend updating everything simultaneously.
assertions: Classifies this as a Major repositioning needing the full cascade
Prioritizes live/active surfaces (ads, campaigns, email/SMS, homepage) first
Sequences owned content, then partner-facing, then earned/third-party in that order
Explicitly avoids recommending simultaneous updates to everything

evals.prompt: We sell through a dealer network and just repositioned. Anything special to consider?
evals.expected_output: Should flag that dealers need advance notice before customer-facing repositioning affects shared or co-branded materials, referencing marketing-strategy's distribution-model-guide. Should note dealer-facing materials and POS materials as part of the Sales and partner-facing tier of the cascade, and that a dealer caught off guard is a relationship cost on top of the marketing cost.
assertions: Flags the need for advance dealer notice before shared materials change
References the distribution-model-guide / dealer coordination context
Identifies dealer-facing and POS materials as part of the cascade
Notes the relationship cost of not notifying dealers in advance
